report_name: Origin Energy Confirms Major Data Breach Affecting 4.8M Customers

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Threat Actor
threat_actors.description: An unidentified threat actor who compromised Origin Energy's systems, stole customer data, and threatened to leak it unless a ransom was paid. The attack is characterized as a ransomware or extortion-style operation focused on data leakage.
threat_actors.goals: To extort a ransom payment from Origin Energy by threatening to leak stolen customer data.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: The attacker compromised a core customer database or a related application server to steal a large volume of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) for 4.8 million customers, including names, addresses, dates of birth, and partial financial details.

identities.name: Origin Energy
identities.description: A major Australian energy and internet provider that was the victim of a significant data breach, potentially exposing the personal information of its 4.8 million customers.
